description: Contact-stability retry from trial003's final checkpoint. Add dimensionally scaled leg-target-rate and wheel-link vertical-velocity penalties, providing dense training signals even when Isaac contacts remain supported. The latter is link-origin velocity, not contact-point separation. Preserve the same reference, 50 Hz policy / 200 Hz physics, gains, motor randomization, friction, explicit soft-contact calibration and all acceptance thresholds. Final checkpoint is predesignated after 600 additional updates. No hardware or statistical robustness claim.
